scope: 已批准的管理员只读预检；未发送信号或写时钟参数。
requested_stdin:
stty -echo
/bin/sh <<'A2_READONLY_SCRIPT'
id
printf 'ROOT_PID_NAMESPACE\n'
readlink /proc/1/ns/pid
readlink /proc/self/ns/pid
printf 'BOOT_ID\n'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'CHRONYD_IDENTITY\n'
cat /proc/308/stat
sed -n '/^Name:/p;/^State:/p;/^Pid:/p;/^PPid:/p;/^NSpid:/p' /proc/308/status
readlink /proc/308/exe
stat -Lc '%d %i %s %Y' /proc/308/exe
readlink /proc/308/ns/pid
readlink /proc/308/ns/mnt
tr '\000' '\n' < /proc/308/cmdline
printf 'ACTIVE_DEFAULT_CONFIG\n'
cat /proc/308/root/etc/chrony.conf
printf 'CHRONY_VERSION\n'
/proc/308/exe -v
printf 'CHRONY_TRACKING\n'
chronyc -n tracking
printf 'PARENT\n'
cat /proc/1/comm
readlink /proc/1/exe
printf 'CLOCKSOURCE\n'
cat /sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource
printf 'UBUNTU_ROOT_CANDIDATE\n'
for entry in /proc/[0-9]*/ns/pid; do
  ns=$(readlink "$entry") || continue
  if [ "$ns" = 'pid:[4026532235]' ]; then
    base=$(dirname "$(dirname "$entry")")
    if [ -x "$base/root/usr/bin/python3" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$base"
      cat "$base/comm"
      sed -n '/^NSpid:/p' "$base/status"
      cat "$base/root/etc/os-release"
      printf 'PYTHON_CHECK\n'
      chroot "$base/root" /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,sys,ctypes,time; print(sys.version); print(os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/pid") if os.path.exists("/proc/self/ns/pid") else "root PID outside mounted proc namespace"); print(os.pread(3,0,0) if False else os.listdir(3)[:3]); print(hasattr(os,"pidfd_open")); print(time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW))' 3</proc
      break
    fi
  fi
done
printf '\nA2_END_7350b06288bfe92a\n'
A2_READONLY_SCRIPT
exit
